ngaap.guidance: 2024 guidance (25-Jul-2024): Revenue $21.0B - $21.3B (prior $20.8B - $21.3B); adjusted segment operating margin 15.2% - 15.4% (prior > 15%); Non-GAAP EPS $12.85 - $13.15 (prior $12.70 - $13.05); adjusted free cash flow ~$2.2B. Segments: SAS revenue ~$7,000M, margin low 12% (prior ~12%); IMS revenue $6,500 - $6,700M (prior $6,400 - $6,600M), margin mid 11% (prior low-mid 11%); CS revenue $5,300 - $5,400M, margin mid 24% (prior low-mid 24%); AR revenue $2,400 - $2,500M, margin high 11%. Other: FAS/CAS operating adjustment ~$30M; non-service FAS pension income ~$310M; net interest expense ~$660M (prior ~$650M); effective tax rate on non-GAAP income 13.0% - 13.5%; average diluted shares flat (prior flat - up slightly); capital expenditures ~2% of sales. LHX NeXt: costs totaling $400M through 2025; gross run-rate savings of $1B exiting year 3.
ngaap.notes: Adjusted segment operating income/margin = operating income excluding the FAS/CAS operating adjustment, unallocated corporate department expense and the significant / non-recurring items (amortization of acquisition-related intangibles and inventory step-up, merger / acquisition / divestiture-related expenses, divestiture losses and impairments, LHX NeXt implementation costs); in 2024 it equals the sum of segment operating income except where a segment-level impairment is added back (Q4-24 / FY24: $24M at CS). Non-GAAP EPS (2024 basis) = diluted EPS + amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (and inventory step-up) + merger, acquisition and divestiture-related expenses + business divestiture-related losses / impairment of goodwill and other assets + LHX NeXt implementation costs, less income taxes on the adjustments (and NCI portion). Effective tax rate on non-GAAP income = (income taxes + tax on the same items) / (income before income taxes + the items). Adjusted free cash flow = net cash from operating activities - additions to PP&E (net of proceeds from sale of PP&E where shown) + cash used for merger, acquisition and severance (severance included from 2024; prior-year comparatives reclassified). Organic revenue excludes completed divestitures and first-year acquisition revenue (Aerojet Rocketdyne until 28-Jul-2024). The quarter (three-month) free cash flow bridge is recorded; year-to-date: operating cash flow 650, additions to PP&E (212), free cash flow 438, cash used for merger, acquisition and severance 120, adjusted free cash flow 558. items_tax_effect is the sum of the per-item tax amounts in Table 6. LHX NeXt costs Q2: workforce optimization $1M, other $47M.
